how_to_use: Look up the abstract concept (target) you need to express; each listed SOURCE is a concrete domain you can draw from. `source_words` are the vocabulary of that domain and make good motif seeds. Skip items with domain_specific=true unless the brief is about politics/governance; MetaNet was built for that program and is heavy on it.
